description: Show the same general enemy level curve in the encounter enemy summary as in battle (display only).

edits.old: ' (' + Math.round(x.d.hp * f) + ' ХП, удар ~' + Math.round(x.d.atk * f) + ')'
edits.new: ' (' + Math.round(x.d.hp * f * (B.enemyCurve ? B.enemyCurve(e.level, 'hp') : 1)) + ' ХП, удар ~' + Math.round(x.d.atk * f * (B.enemyCurve ? B.enemyCurve(e.level, 'atk') : 1)) + ')'
